Fake Franchise - James McCallum

By: Carol Albertyn Christie | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Further information:
James McCallum - Swindler extraordinaire.
I would probably have bought a franchise from him. Ok, maybe not so much after I saw his video where he showcased a rather lethal knife. A knife that looked less like bushcraft and more like violent self-defence.

James McCallum is very self-assured, arrogant and undoubtedly opinionated. He sells himself as a guru in the business world and sells franchises for property inspector companies, solar power and even silver bullion as an investment. Last week he said he talked to Anton de Ruyter about ESKOM. He says he has 15 years in the industry and has turned over more than R 20 billion in 6 different sectors.
The basic scam is he has 3 franchise opportunities. You buy into his franchise, your money buys you an area to operate from, training, software and a business plan. You pay the money, sign and send the contract back and then...
He keeps the contract. The training material is almost non-existent and the document I saw was plagiarised, the software is cumbersome, and the business plan had to be written by hand. When you question his means or methods, you unleash a most violent and vituperative response. He threatens bodily harm, is verbally abusive, and admits to taking drugs.

All of the people I have spoken to who bought into his franchise, and there are many, say similar things. His modus operandi is the same across the board. Of the 15 or so people i have spoken to, he has scammed them of about R 500K.

Who is Roger McCallum ?
He has three franchise opportunities.
IPI - Property Inspections Franchise (SACHI)
IPC - Solar Energy Consulting (Retrosol) SolarSearch
Silver Bullion SA 23 September 2022
and
South African Carbon and Energy Exchange

His biography
I was born in Swansea South Wales in 1970 and arrived in Johannesburg when I was 16. Initially I completed an N6 in Photo Mechanics before leaving for Sodwana Bay where I spent 5 years as a Naui Dive Master managing large groups of people on 938 sea dives, it’s here where I developed my passion for photography, travel, the environment and by default developed critical leadership skills which 20 years later translated into my current field of expertise. Essentially I help people change economic lanes, examining the employee mentality whilst teaching the pathology of self determination and entrepreneurship. I founded a franchise based Solar Energy Company called RetroSol & a Property Inspection Company, SACHI to provide not only the soft skills but also a realistic mechanism to carry their actions forward to financial & time freedom.
Personal Info.
• Name: James Philip McCallum
• Birthdate: February 21, 1970
• Address: Cape Town City
• Phone: +27 (0)76 132 8954
• E-mail: md@sacex.co.za
• Interests: Traveling the Italian Peninsula, Boxing, Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Coach, Filipino Silat, Vedic Astrology, Porsche Air Cooled 911 design, History, Global Economics, Psychology, B&W Film Photography, collecting Antique Persian Carpets and Japanese Wood Block Prints.

Business Activity.
As the founder of SACEX, The South African Carbon & Energy Exchange my focus is in developing business models which can be duplicated through a skills transfer program we call the "system for success". My Businesses include The South African Association of Certified Home Inspectors, RetroSol Solar Energy Consulting & Engineering and UrbanRain, for Both the residential & commercial sector. We build our brands through a standard franchise system and have trained over 500 would be entrepreneurs across all 3 sectors since 2006.
My Experience.
6
Successful Startups in 6 Sectors
20
Billion Turnover in own Business since 2002
180
Successful Franchise Training Modules
564
Launched Franchise Startups in 3 Sectors

Interviews

1. James McCallum

I have private investigators who are trying to triangulate his cell phone position. He may be in Paarl or Franschhoek. I have contacted McCallum by email posing as a potential buyer and will phone him from a burnerphone in due course. Speaks about being fired from 4 businesses fired. Also mentions drug rehab.

Visuals – YouTube videos and franchise advertising

2. Melvern Young Mossel Bay
0742167657
4 Lineata Street, Dana Bay, Mossel Bay
Paid R 19500 in 2022.
Before IPI, diamond mine manager in Angola. Before the original lockdown in COVID. Here 6 or 7 months of management of mines from here. Decided to stay in SA and start a company provides complete service for people selling homes.
First Refusal Property in mid-2021. Saw IPI on a FB advert in June 2022.
Liked idea. Saw errors in the contract and became worried and thought to give the benefit of the doubt. Things fell apart after that.
Has taken out a protection order against McCallum. But he hasn’t found him to give him the order. But the court has spoken to McCallum who said he had COVID and after that no contact.

Visuals – Melvern and family at home. Doing a home inpection. Chat to wife.
At computer.

3. Gert Toerien – Nigel (40 minutes from Johannesburg)
0823190573
You had a gardening business and saw IPI ad on Facebook contacted him in July, and you paid. Special only a few days and then going to do live training again online for now. Forced to make a decision as quickly. We were not allowed to create our own Facebook posts. End of August, beginning of Sept. Recently this year. Sent a link for Solar Panels. Never send me emails again. You are a scammer; leave us alone.
Noycedale. The family reaction that you were scammed. Scammed before a crypto thing. Trained hypnotist. Tell Devi to bring a wide lens to fit in your double chin.

Visuals – at his gardening business. At home with family.

4. John Graham – CT SAHITA
083 3109 766
Independent Home Inspector
John Graham is the Executive Chairman of HouseCheck and is dedicated to making the property market place more transparent and fair for buyers, sellers and estate agents. He is the author of The South African Home Buyers Guide and the South African Home Inspection Training Academies text book. He works tirelessly to ensure that buyers, sellers and estate agents have adequate information to structure deals that are in the best interests of all parties in a property purchase. He can be contacted on or by emailing john@www.housecheck.co.za

Visuals – At office. He will arrange a couple of home inspections to film.


5. Selwyn Zackon - Franchising lawyer
Will answer questions about franchises and whether any legal recourse from all of the claimants.
Ashersons Attorneys
First Floor
Ashersons Chambers
34 Plein Street
Cape Town, 8001
+27 21 461 6240
info@ashersons.co.za

Visuals – at his office. Looking through McCallum documents.


6. Cell phone recordings of 12 other case studies.
I will get the other participants to answer a couple of questions and use them interspersed in the programme like a big screen of people.


Questions
How did you hear about IPI Property Inspectors?
What year was this?
Did he say the law was changing and home inspections were mandatory?
Did you sign a contract?
Did he send a signed contract back to you?
How much money did you lose with McCallum?
What was the quality of his training material like?
And the software that you were provided with?
Were there any hidden costs?
What went wrong in your dealings with IPI?
Has he threatened you?
Did you ever inspect a home?
In what way do you think McCallum has acted unlawfully -he provided some training material and software?

Script:


Fake Franchiser Friday Viewing 4 - 18 May 2023

SOUND ENGINEER

PLEASE BEEP ALL THE SWEAR WORDS FUCK, CUNT AND ASS AT THE END

AND PUT A GAVEL SOUND WHEN THE JUDGE BANGS IT.

V/O
A new business venture… the power to steer your own destiny… a future filled with promise.
And an investment in a franchise offers a greater chance at success.
Unless the person who sells you the franchise is not who you thought they were…

Actor Voice for James
(Finalmix - Beep Cunt and Fuck)
Hey cunt. 
Know this. I never let it go. Ever.
You stepped on some toes stupid. It's coming. Fuck the law. I want a reckoning.

V/O 
These are real threats made to actual franchisees by this man: James McCallum.

James
You mentioned you like guns.

 Melvern.
He sent me photos of himself behind a gun aiming at me and says how this gun can penetrate
soft tissue.

V/O
And he didn’t stop there…

Gert
That he is actually going to get someone to plant 1 kg of Mandrax in her car and get the SAPS to arrest her.

V/O
Mossel Bay - a harbour town in the southern Cape experiencing a “semigration” boom as people move here from other provinces. It’s where Melvern Young owns a new real estate company… and from where he now battles the man, he says, defrauded him of thousands.
Bongani
You assume I am a home inspector. No, it’s a cash business for cash laundry for oxycontin. Million in cash every month since 2012. You stepped on some toes stupid.
Melvern
Soon after you say something is wrong you want to withdraw; this is the type of threats you get.
V/O
In this bizarre WhatsApp exchange, James McCallum implies the franchise Melvern bought into is actually a type of laundry for dirty drug money. A claim McCallum strongly denies.

Bongani
At what point did you think to go to the police?
Melvern
Directly after this last one.

V/O
Melvern was advised by a magistrate to get a protection order against McCallum.
The protection order was delivered to his home address in Pietermaritzburg and both times it came back as undeliverable.
V/O
McCallum’s business is a simple one. It has a fancy title: The South African Association of Certified Home Inspectors or SACHI IPI or Independent Property Inspectors. And a catchy tag line: We Inspect What You Expect. For an upfront fee of R4 750 and more unexpected instalments after that, franchisees are “trained” to become home inspectors. And after a 7-step process taking anywhere between two and six weeks, they’re ready to help provide peace of mind to prospective home buyers for a fee of around R 5000. It’s a business, McCallum claims, that can earn his franchisees as much as R 75 000 a month.
Up Sound James video
Having a professional home inspection from a leading home inspection company will give you peace of mind and give you assist you in a smooth and fair transaction.

V/O
And why would potential franchisees doubt him? After all, he’s a self-professed creative genius who, according to his personal website, claims to have generated 20 billion rand from franchise businesses since 2002.
Sadly, Melvern’s faith in the franchise was misplaced. His investment, he says, bought him precisely nothing.
Pause for scene change.

V/O

After dodging them for 10 months, the authorities eventually caught up with McCallum at a coffee shop and served Melvern’s protection order.

Mntu
I have some documents here, a protection order from Young.
James
Yes I do.
Mntu
This is the person who has requested me to serve this, because obviously some business went sour or something. And because of that he feels that he is being intimidated.
James
You could have just told me you would serve me with a Protection Order and I would have been here. No problem.

V/O
Melvern isn’t McCallum’s only dissatisfied customer: we spoke to 30 people all over the country who bought into the SACHI scheme.  Melvern parted with 19-and-a-half-thousand Rand of his hard-earned money, and we found another investor who lost just under 22 000 rand.

Gert
I thought of becoming a home inspector. I like challenges, and that is something brand new and I though that is a challenge let me go for it. That is a challenge for me.


V/O
A keen fisherman, Gert Toerien fell for McCallum’s marketing spin hook, line, and sinker. But, when the promised training didn’t materialise, he says the “creative genius” turned abusive.
Gert
He did not give us any proper training on the home inspection side which I did not know anything about. When I confronted him and told him that he is basically scamming us out of our monies, and it is not only me but a couple of other people that I know of. That is when he sent me a threat, threatening my daughter that he is going to get someone to plant 1 kg of mandrax in her car.
That means 5 years jail for her.

V/O
The complaints overwhelming, we wanted answers from McCallum himself.

Bongani
Hello, James?
James
Yes. 
Bongani
This is Bongani from
Carte Blanche.

V/O
He agreed to talk to us about the allegations, including the abuse directed at Melvern.

B
Why did you become aggressive when you are questioned?
James
Yes, it got ugly and it got ugly on both sides.
B
You said you were going to shoot him.
J
No, I didn’t say I was going to shoot him.
B
You send pictures of yourself loading guns. 
J
That doesn’t mean I am going to shoot anybody. That picture is on Facebook. But he was becoming harassing and it was getting to the point where I was losing my temper.

V/O
James also denied threatening Gert’s daughter, saying WhatsApps are often taken out of context.


V/O
McCallum claimed that both Melvern and Gert had threatened him and his livelihood.
Then he added that he’d been in this business for 17 years… which is surprising, given arguably his biggest selling point is a complete fabrication.

Bongani Link
It’s a really sleek ad, an industry in its infancy with enormous potential, no huge upfront capital costs, full training, custom software and the promise that you are getting in early who could resist? 
James
The idea is good. South Africa is ready for its consumers to be protected by this act.

V/O
You see, McCallum convinced the franchisees that when the new Property Practitioner’s Act replaced the existing law, it would make home inspections mandatory. This is a lie.

Bongani
As part of your sell for SACHI did you not tell prospective franchisees that this was now mandatory according to South African law and that is why you were opening this opportunity?
James
if I buy your home, Bongani, you have got to supply me with a piece of paper, which is an inspection report that you and the real estate agents have done, stating that there are no issues.
Or problems with that property. Correct?
Bongani
That doesn't require that does not require a property inspector.
James
No, it doesn't. But it should because it's a conflict of interests.

V/O
And there you have it: an inspection was mandatory because James McCallum believed it should be.   And, if he’s to be believed, McCullam has trained more than 300 people.

Bongani
Have you got examples of the successes of other people who have done well?
James
Sure, I can even you the name of someone who has done very well. His name is Paul Nieuwoudt. We trained him and he has gone on to successfully grow a programme with over 50 inspectors through our programme.

UPS from Nieuwoudt call
Ha, Ha, Ha. James McCallum?

VO: But when we followed up with Paul Niewoudt, McCallum’s star franchisee didn’t exactly provide a ringing endorsement

Paul
He’s good at taking people’s money, including mine that he took in 2019. I decided to go on my own and do my own thing. He is a BS of note.

Pause

We showed the SACHI contract to a lawyer who described it as “cobbled together” and “not legally enforceable”.

Bongani
I mean I am looking at some of the agreements that you have offered your so-called contract it’s riddled with grammar and spelling errors. This is so amateurish. It’s quite shocking.

James
Listen don’t be belligerent. Do not be belligerent. If you want to go back in time. And don’t raise your eyebrows at me either.
Bongani
What are you going to do to me? Are you also going to send me pictures of your torso with your gun?

V/O
Gert and Melvern admit they should have done better due diligence before handing over their cash. But both were entitled to change their minds about the deal within 10 days.
Unsurprisingly, McCullam takes a different view.

Bongani 
Within 10 days they are allowed to change their minds.

J
Yes and No

B
No there is no no, there’s no, no about it James
J
Why I say yes and no Bongani is because the Consumer Protection Act is developed for individuals who are unable or who have not got the level of education to do full due diligence on the opportunity
Bongani
There are no laws for dumb people and laws for clever people James
James
Look I am giving you my opinion, I am not an attorney, I am telling you what I think.
Bongani
No, and I am telling you the law.
V/O
And the law suggests that McCallum may be guilty of presenting agreements to the public which aren’t compliant with the Consumer Protection Act. And that’s not only unethical but illegal.
Bongani
You have admitted that the courses that you offer are not certified with any professional body in South Africa. You are not registered it is all a figment of your imagination.
James
Eskom CEO was poisoned haven’t you got anything better to do?
Bongani
What do you think should happen to him?

BEEP ASS

Gert
His ass must be behind bars, they must throw the keys away and he must never get out again.


Promos


Promo 1 – 11 seconds

V/O
From a fair business handshake to a loaded gun. This is the twisted tale of an alleged serial scamster.

UPS – You stepped on some toes. I want a reckoning.


Promo 2 x 21 secs

VO

They dared to chase their business dreams. Little did they know, the charming franchisor concealed a sinister plan. Uncover the shocking truth behind the franchisee's nightmare.

UPS: .... You mentioned you like guns.








Promo 3

VO:
Their dream: an adventure of a lifetime, starting their own business. The persuasive online offer promised success with a tested franchise template. But the reality? A horrifying collapse.

UPS: Gert: His ass must be behind bars, they must throw the keys away and he must never get out again.

metadata.Further information: James McCallum - Swindler extraordinaire. I would probably have bought a franchise from him. Ok, maybe not so much after I saw his video where he showcased a rather lethal knife. A knife that looked less like bushcraft and more like violent self-defence. James McCallum is very self-assured, arrogant and undoubtedly opinionated. He sells himself as a guru in the business world and sells franchises for property inspector companies, solar power and even silver bullion as an investment. Last week he said he talked to Anton de Ruyter about ESKOM. He says he has 15 years in the industry and has turned over more than R 20 billion in 6 different sectors. The basic scam is he has 3 franchise opportunities. You buy into his franchise, your money buys you an area to operate from, training, software and a business plan. You pay the money, sign and send the contract back and then... He keeps the contract. The training material is almost non-existent and the document I saw was plagiarised, the software is cumbersome, and the business plan had to be written by hand. When you question his means or methods, you unleash a most violent and vituperative response. He threatens bodily harm, is verbally abusive, and admits to taking drugs. All of the people I have spoken to who bought into his franchise, and there are many, say similar things. His modus operandi is the same across the board. Of the 15 or so people i have spoken to, he has scammed them of about R 500K. Who is Roger McCallum ? He has three franchise opportunities.
